title: Western Blot (semi-dry)
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8fdhti6
materials: Equilibrate PCDF-Membrane for 5 minutes in Anode buffer

steps.title: Equilibrate Gel
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the gel in Cathode buffer for 30 minutes without shaking.

steps.title: Activate PCDF-Membrane
steps.instruction: Activate the PCDF-Membrane in MeOH for approximately 20 seconds, then incubate for 2 minutes in dH2O without shaking.

steps.title: Prepare Blotting Papers
steps.instruction: Prepare blotting papers (1 mm thickness each) for the anode and cathode.

substeps.instruction: Wet two blotting papers in Anode buffer and place on Anode.
Wet two blotting papers in Cathode buffer and place on gel.

steps.title: Assemble Blot Sandwich
steps.instruction: Assemble the blot components, ensuring they are cut as exactly as possible to the gel size (accounting for gel expansion during equilibration).

substeps.instruction: Place each component exactly on top of each other.
Eliminate air bubbles after each step by rolling them out with a glass rod and buffer.

steps.title: Run Blot
steps.instruction: Run the blot at 1.5 mA/cm2 for 90 minutes (adjust duration based on protein size).

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane with TBST + 5% milk powder for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Wash membrane with TBST and incubate with primary antibody for at least 1 hour at room temperature (RT) or overnight at 4°C.

substeps.instruction: Use the minimum volume possible to preserve the antibody.

steps.title: Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane for 10 minutes in TBST. Repeat this process 3 times.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Add secondary antibody and incubate for at least 45 minutes at RT or overnight at 4°C while swiveling gently.

steps.title: Wash Membrane
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane for 10 minutes in TBST. Repeat this process 3 times.

steps.title: Develop and Detect
steps.instruction: Develop the membrane using Bio-Rad Clarity Western.

substeps.instruction: Mix Bio-Rad Clarity Western 1:1 (approximately 1 ml per membrane).
Let membrane drain and evenly add developer to membrane using a 1 ml tip.
Use Chemi or Chemi-high Sensitivity, Signal Accumulation mode, and transmission light for ladder detection.
Take a picture of the membrane for merging.
Incubate at RT for 5-15 minutes (under the hood).
Remove and wash again in TBS.
